inputs.name: ZERO
inputs.meaning: 1=the counter timing this phase has run out

outputs.name: PWM
outputs.meaning: the wave itself: the phase is the output

outputs.name: CNT_LOAD
outputs.meaning: 1=start the counter on the phase being entered

LOW.meaning: the wave is low; the counter is timing the OFF half (PERIOD - DUTY cycles)

HIGH.meaning: the wave is high; the counter is timing the ON half (DUTY cycles)

transitions.when: the off half has run out while the core is running
the core is stopped, or the off half has cycles left
the on half has run out, or the core stopped
the on half has cycles left
